sentence_1_it: I cervi una volta erano la selvaggina principale.
sentence_1_en: Deer were once the main game.
sentence_2_it: In molte parti del mondo è illegale sparare a della selvaggina come cervi, alci o fagiani.
sentence_2_en: In many parts of the world it is illegal to shoot wild game such as deer, moose or pheasant.
